title: 第10章 代理伍正
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“呵呵，林姑爷来了。”

没等林珝开口，刘师爷已经捋着胡须站起来，脸上挂着客客气气的笑容，还指了指案前的一张凳子，示意林珝坐下说话。

“几天前，三小姐把你的事情告诉了老寨主。”

“老寨主听说之后还算满意，想给你谋个差事，为山寨效力。”

刘师爷翻开面前的名册，手指在上面轻轻敲了两下，“前哨营还缺个带队的。不知道姑爷意下如何？”

林珝听得心头一跳。

来之前他想过好几种可能，管粮草、守寨门，甚至连跑腿打杂都想到了——唯独没想到会是前哨营。

山寨虽然名义上是土匪窝，但常年和乌勒人拉锯，内部早就仿照军队的架构分了编制。

除了中军营和粮草营，最紧要的就是前哨营。

里面的人专门负责刺探敌情、勘察地形，相当于上一世的侦察兵。

虽然危险，却是个露脸的肥差。

“既然寨主信得过，我一定尽心竭力。”

林珝没有犹豫，干脆利落地应了下来。

可话音刚落，旁边的马奎就开了口，“刘师爷，“这小子进山还不到半个月，前哨营是多要紧的地方，怎么能交到他手上？”

刘师爷不急不缓地捋了捋胡须，“这是老寨主的意思。马头领要是有意见，可以去议事厅找他老人家当面商议。”

马奎哼了一声，把后背往椅背上一靠。

“为这点小事，还犯不上惊动寨主，我是怕这小子不知天高地厚，以为侥幸杀了一个乌勒人就了不得了。”

他偏过头，拿那双精光毕露的眼睛上下扫了林珝一遍，嘴角掀开一抹弧度，

“前哨营可是个要命的地方。”

山脚下乌勒人蠢蠢欲动，去了前线，是要死人的。

老老实实当个太平姑爷不好。

“万一年纪轻轻就折在外头，岂不是要害三小姐守活寡？”

这番话听着像是在关心，但语气里那股阴阳怪气的味道，比直接骂人还刺耳。

林珝没有接话，却盘算起了疤哥临死前说过的那番话。

在自己进入黑风寨之前，二寨主本来盘算着让马奎娶三小姐，结果被自己这个半路杀出来的“姑爷”搅了局。

这么一看，马奎对自己的敌意根本不关刀疤什么事，根源应该在这儿。

Page (1/3)

"Haha, Uncle Lin is here."

Before Lin Jue could speak, Master Liu had already stood up, stroking his beard, with a polite smile on his face. He also pointed to a stool in front of the case, gesturing for Lin Jue to sit down and talk.

"A few days ago, Third Miss told the old village leader about you."

"The old village master was quite satisfied after hearing about it. He wants to find a job for you to work for the village."

Master Liu opened the roster in front of him and tapped it twice with his fingers. "The outpost camp is still short of a leader. I wonder what your wishes are?"

Lin Jue's heart skipped a beat when she heard this.

Before coming, he thought about several possibilities, including managing food and grass, guarding the village gate, and even running errands - but he never thought it would be an outpost camp.

Although the village is nominally a bandit den, it has been at loggerheads with the Ule people all year round, and its internal organization has long been divided into organizations based on the structure of the army.

In addition to the Central Military Camp and the Grain and Grass Camp, the most important thing is the outpost camp.

The people inside are responsible for spying on the enemy and surveying the terrain, which is equivalent to the scouts in the previous life.

Although dangerous, he is a fat bastard who shows off his face.

"Since the leader of the village can be trusted, I will do my best."

Lin Jue didn't hesitate and responded quickly.

But as soon as he finished speaking, Ma Kui next to him said, "Master Liu," this kid has been in the mountain for less than half a month. The outpost camp is such an important place, how can it be left in his hands?"

Master Liu stroked his beard unhurriedly and said, "This is what the old village leader meant.If the leader Ma has any objections, he can go to the meeting hall to discuss with him face to face."

Ma Kui snorted and leaned back on the chair.

"For such a trivial matter, it's not enough to alarm the village leader. I'm afraid that this guy doesn't know the heights of the world and thinks that it's a big deal if he kills a Ule man by luck."

He turned his head, scanned Lin Jue up and down with his shining eyes, and curved the corner of his mouth.

"Outpost Camp is a terrible place."

The Ule people at the foot of the mountain are ready to make a move and go to the front line to kill people.

It's not good to be a peacekeeper.

"If I stay out at such a young age, wouldn't it mean that the third lady will become a widow?"

The words sounded like he was concerned, but the yin and yang flavor in his tone was harsher than directly cursing someone.

Lin Jue didn't answer, but thought about what Brother Scar said before he died.

Before he entered Heifeng Village, the second village leader originally planned to let Ma Kui marry the third lady, but the situation was disrupted by his "uncle" who came out halfway.

Looking at it this way, Ma Kui's hostility towards him has nothing to do with Scar at all, the root cause should be here.
